seeds.text: Presence doesn't solve problems. It dissolves the level the problem was constructed on.
When you wash the dishes, wash the dishes. The mind that's somewhere else is the mind that misses its own life.
You didn't come into this world. You came out of it — the way a wave comes out of an ocean. Separation is the optical illusion.
Trying to define yourself is like trying to bite your own teeth. The looker can't be the looked-at.
You don't become present. You stop pretending you were ever anywhere else.

slides.composition: A shimmering chrome keyhole, slightly off-center, reveals a swirling galaxy beyond, framed by soft airbrush clouds.

slides.text: The feeling of 'searching' is the only thing keeping you from it.
slides.composition: A single, glossy, 90s anime hand reaching outwards towards a distant, shimmering, undefined light, rendered with subtle VHS lines.

slides.text: Presence doesn’t fix problems. It melts the *level* they're on.
slides.composition: A chrome orb, slightly glitching at the edges, slowly dissolving into a starry nebula background with prismatic light bursts.

slides.text: Trying to grasp who you 'are' is the *self-grasping trap*.
slides.composition: A fractured marble statue head, partially submerged in liquid silver, trying to gaze at its own distorted reflection.

slides.text: The part of you that looks can't be the part it's looking for.
slides.composition: Two ethereal, chrome-plated figures, one looking intently forward, the other dissolving into a deep navy starfield, back to back.

slides.text: You don't *become* present. You just stop pretending you're not.
slides.composition: An overhead top-down view of a vast, tranquil, liquid silver lake reflecting a soft, cloud-filled sky above.

slides.text: There's nothing left to do but breathe, and just be here.
slides.composition: A close-up of soft, pastel pink and gold glitter dust settling gently onto a deep indigo velvet surface, with subtle lens flare.

caption:
That 'searching' feeling? It's the only thing keeping you from being exactly where you are. You're already here. Breathe.
